description: This file defines a PHP function additionalDetailsCampaign used to generate an overlib string with campaign details for display in a UI. It interacts with global variables and uses language translation functions specific to the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM ecosystem.

methods.name: additionalDetailsCampaign
methods.description: Generates formatted campaign details for display, including start date, tracker text, URL, objective, and content snippets, based on input fields.
